1.1: Hakkol shochatin ushechitatan keshera, chutz mecheresh, shote, vekatan, shemma yekalkelu vishchitatan. vechullan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan, shechitatan keshera. shechitat nachri, nevela, umetammea vemassa. hashshochet ballayla, vechen hassuma sheshshachat, shechitato cheshera. hashshochet beshabbat, uveyom hakkippurim, af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho, shechitato cheshera:
1.2: Hashshochet bemaggal yad, betzor, uvekane, shechitato cheshera. hakkol shochatin uleolam shochatin, uvakkol shochatin, chutz mimmaggal katzir, vehammegera, vehashshinnayim, vehatztzipporen, mippene shehen chonkin. hashshochet bemaggal katzir bederech halichatah, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. veim hecheliku shinneha, hare hi chesakkin:
1.3: Hashshochet mittoch hattabbaat veshiyyer bah melo hachut al pene chullah, shechitato cheshera. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, melo hachut al pene rubbah:
1.4: Hashshochet min hatztzedadin shechitato cheshera. hammolek min hatztzedadin, melikato fesula. hashshochet min haoref, shechitato fesula. hammolek min haoref, melikato cheshera. hashshochet min hatztzavvar, shechitato cheshera. hammolek min hatztzavvar, melikato fesula, shekkol haoref kasher limlika, vechol hatztzavvar kasher lishchita. nimtza, kasher bishchita, pasul bimlika. kasher bimlika, pasul bishchita:
1.5: Kasher battorin, pasul bivne yona. kasher bivne yona, pasul battorin. techillat hatztzihuv, baze uvaze pasul:
1.6: Kasher bappara, pasul baegla. kasher baegla, pasul bappara. kasher bakkohanim, pasul balviyyim. kasher balviyyim, pasul bakkohanim. tahor bichle cheres, tame vechol hakkelim. tahor bechol hakkelim, tame vichle chares. tahor bichle etz, tame vichle mattachot. tahor bichle mattachot, tame vichle etz. hachayyav bashshekedim hammarim, patur bammetukim. hachayyav bammetukim, patur bammarim:
1.7: Hattemed, ad shello hechemitz, eno nikkach bechesef maaser, ufosel et hammikve. mishshehechemitz, nikkach bechesef maaser veeno fosel et hammikve. haachin hashshuttafin, keshechayyavin bakkalbon, peturin mimmasar behema. keshechayyavin bemasar behema, peturin min hakkalbon. kol makom sheyyesh mecher, en kenas. vechol makom sheyyesh kenas, en macher. kol makom sheyyesh meun, en chalitza. vechol makom sheyyesh chalitza, en meun. kol makom sheyyesh tekia, en havedala. vechol makom sheyyesh havedala, en tekia. yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, tokin velo mavdilin. bemotzae shabbat, mavdilin velo tokin. ketzad mavdilin, hammavdil ben kodesh lekodesh. rabbi dosa omer, ben kodesh chamur lekodesh hakkal:

2.1: Hashshochet echad baof, ushenayim babbehema, shechitato cheshera. verubbo shel echad, kamohu. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyishchot et havveridin. chatzi echad baof, veechad vachetzi babbehema, shechitato fesula. rov echad baof verov shenayim babbehema, shechitato cheshera:
2.2: Hashshochet shene rashin keechad, shechitato cheshera. shenayim ochazin bassakkin veshochatin, afillu echad lemala veechad lematta, shechitatan keshera:
2.3: Hittiz et harosh bevat achat, pesula. haya shochet vehittiz et harosh bevat achat, im yesh bassakkin melo tzavvar, keshera. haya shochet vehittiz shene rashim bevat achat, im yesh bassakkin melo tzavvar echad, keshera. bamme devarim amurim. bizman sheholich velo hevi, o hevi velo holich. aval im holich vehevi, afillu chol shehu, afillu veizmel, keshera. nafla sakkin veshachata, af al pi sheshshachata chedarkah, pesula, shenneemar (Devarim 12), vezavachta veachalta, ma sheatta zoveach, atta ochel. nafla hassakkin vehigbihah, naflu chelav vehigbihan, hishchiz et hassakkin veaf, uva chavero veshachat, im shaha chede shechita, pesula. rabbi shimon omer, im shaha chede vikkur:
2.4: Shachat et havveshet ufasak et haggargeret, o shachat et haggargeret ufasak et havveshet, o sheshshachat achad mehen vehimtin lah ad shemmeta, o shehechelid et hassakkin tachat hashsheni ufesako, rabbi yeshevav omer, nevela. rabbi akiva omer, terefa. kelal amar rabbi yeshevav mishshum rabbi yehoshua, kol shennifsela vishchitatah, nevela. kol sheshshechitatah karauy vedavar acher garam lah lippasel, terefa. vehoda lo rabbi akiva:
2.5: Hashshochet behema chayya veof velo yatza mehen dam, kesherim, veneechalim beyadayim mesoavot, lefi shello huchsheru vedam. rabbi shimon omer, huchsheru vashshechita:
2.6: Hashshochet et hamesukkenet, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ad shettefarkes bayyad uvaragel. rabbi eliezer omer, dayyah im zinneka. amar rabbi shimon, af hashshochet ballayla ulemachar hishkim umatza chetalim meleim dam, keshera, shezzinneka, uchemiddat rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, ad shettefarkes o vayyad o varegel o ad shettechashkesh biznavah, echad behema dakka veechad behema gassa. behema dakka sheppashta yadah velo hechezira, pesula, sheenah ella hotzaat nefesh bilvad. bamme devarim amurim, shehayta vechezkat mesukkenet. aval im hayta vechezkat beria, afillu en bah achad mikkol hassimanim hallalu, keshera:
2.7: Hashshochet lenachri, shechitato cheshera. verabbi eliezer posel. amar rabbi eliezer, afillu shechatah sheyyochal hannachri mechatzar kaved shellah, pesula, shessetam machashevet nachri laavoda zara. amar rabbi yose, kal vachomer haddevarim, uma bimkom shehammachashava foselet, bemukdashin, en hakkol holech ella achar haoved, mekom sheen machashava foselet, bechullin, eno din shello yehe hakkol holech ella achar hashshochet:
2.8: Hashshochet leshem harim, leshem gevaot, leshem yammim, leshem neharot, leshem midbarot, shechitato fesula. shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, echad leshem achad mikkol ellu, veechad leshem davar kasher, shechitato fesula:
2.9: En shochatin lo letoch yammim, velo letoch neharot, velo letoch kelim. aval shochet hu letoch uga shel mayim, uvisfina, al gabbe chelim. en shochatin legumma kol ikkar, aval ose gumma vetoch beto bishvil sheyyikkanes haddam letochah. uvashshuk lo yaase chen, shello yechakke et hamminin:
2.10: Hashshochet leshem ola, leshem zevachim, leshem asham taluy, leshem pesach, leshem toda, shechitato fesula. verabbi shimon machshir. shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, echad leshem achad mikkol ellu, veechad leshem davar kasher, shechitato fesula. hashshochet leshem chattat, leshem asham vadday, leshem bechor, leshem maaser, leshem temura, shechitato cheshera. ze hakkelal, kol davar shenniddar venniddav, hashshochet lishmo, asur, vesheeno niddar veniddav, hashshochet lishmo, kasher:

3.1: Ellu terefot babbehema. nekuvat havveshet, ufesukat haggargeret, nikkav kerum shel moach, nikkav hallev levet chalalo, nishbera hashshidra venifsak hachut shellah, nittal hakkaved velo nishtayyer hemennu chelum, harea shennikkeva, o shechasra, rabbi shimon omer, ad shettinnakev levet hassimponot. nikkeva hakkeva, nikkeva hammara, nikkevu haddakkin, hakkeres happenimit shennikkeva, o shennikra rov hachitzona, rabbi yehuda omer, haggedola tefach, vehakketanna berubbah. hameses uvet hakkosot shennikkevu lachutz, nafla min haggag, nishtabberu rov tzaloteha, uderusat hazzeev. rabbi yehuda omer, derusat hazzeev baddakka, uderusat ari baggassa, derusat hannetz baof haddak, uderusat haggas baof haggas. ze hakkelal, kol sheen kamoha chayya, terefa:
3.2: Veellu chesherot babbehema. nikkeva haggargeret o shennisdeka. ad kamma techsar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ad kaissar haitalki. nifchata haggulgolet velo nikkav kerum shel moach, nikkav hallev velo levet chalalo, nishbera hashshidra velo nifsak hachut shellah, nittela hakkaved venishtayyer hemenna chazzayit, hameses uvet hakkosot shennikkevu ze letoch ze, nittal hattechol, nittelu hakkelayot, nittal lechi hattachton, nittal haem shellah, vacharuta vide shamayim. haggeluda, rabbi meir machshir, vachachamim poslin:
3.3: Veellu terefot baof. nekuvat havveshet, pesukat haggargeret, hikkattah chulda al roshah, mekom sheose otah terefa, nikkav hakkurkevan, nikkevu haddakkin, nafla laur venechmeru vene meeha, im yerukkim, pesulin. im adummim, kesherim. derasah, uterafah bakkotel, o sheritztzetzattah behema umefarkeset, veshahata meet leet ushechatah, keshera:
3.4: Veellu chesherot baof. nikkeva haggargeret o shennisdeka, hikkattah chulda al roshah, mekom sheeno ose otah terefa, nikkav hazzefek. rabbi omer, afillu nittal. yatzu vene meeha velo nikkevu, nishtabberu gappeha, nishtabberu ragleha, nimretu chenafeha. rabbi yehuda omer, im nittela hannotza, pesula:
3.5: Achuzat haddam, vehammeushshenet, vehametzunnenet, vesheachla haredufni, vesheachla tzoat tarnegolim, o sheshshatta mayim haraim, keshera. achla sam hammavet o shehikkishah nachash, mutteret mishshum terefa, vaasura mishshum sakkanat nefashot:
3.6: Simane vehema vechayya neemru min hattora, vesimane haof lo neemaru. aval amru chachamim, kol of haddores, tame. kol sheyyesh lo etzba yetera, vezefek, vekurkevano niklaf, tahor. rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer, kol of hacholek et raglav, tame:
3.7: Uvachagavim, kol sheyyesh lo arba raglayim, vearba kenafayim, vekarsullayim, uchenafav chofin et rubbo. rabbi yose omer, ushemo chagav. uvaddagim, kol sheyyesh lo senappir vekaskaset. rabbi yehuda omer, shene kaskassin usenappir echad. veellu hen kaskassin, hakkevuin bo. usenappirin, happoreach bahen:

4.1: Behema hammaksha leled, vehotzi haubbar et yado vehechezirah, muttar baachila. hotzi et rosho, af al pi shehecheziro, hare ze cheyalud. chotech meubbar shebbemeeha, muttar baachila. min hattechol umin hakkelayot, asur baachila. ze hakkelal, davar sheggufah, asur. sheeno gufah, muttar:
4.2: Hamevakkeret hammaksha leled, mechattech evar evar umashlich lakkelavim. yatza rubbo, hare ze yikkaver, veniftera min habbechora:
4.3: Behema shemmet ubbarah betoch meeha vehoshit haroe et yado venaga bo, ben bivhema temea, ben bivhema tehora, tahor. rabbi yose haggelili omer, bitmea, tame, uvithora, tahor. haishsha shemmet veladah betoch meeha ufashta chayya et yadah venaga vo, hachayya temea tumat shiva, vehaishsha tehora ad sheyyetze havvalad:
4.4: Behema hammaksha leled, vehotzi ubbar et yado vachatachah veachar kach shachat et immo, habbasar tahor. shachat et immo veachar kach chatachah, habbasar magga nevela, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, magga terefa shechuta. ma matzinu vatterefa sheshshechitatah metahartah, af shechitat behema tetaher et haevar. amar lahem rabbi meir, lo, im tihara shechitat terefa otah, davar sheggufah, tetaher et haevar, davar sheeno gufah. minnayin latterefa sheshshechitatah metahartah. behema temea asura vaachila, af terefa asura vaachila. ma behema temea en shechitatah metahartah, af terefa lo tetaharenna shechitatah. lo, im amarta bivhema temea shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher, tomar bitrefa shehayta lah sheat hakkosher. tol lecha ma sheheveta, hare shennolda terefa min habbeten minnayin. lo, im amarta bivhema temea shekken en beminah shechita, tomar bitrefa sheyyesh beminah shechita. ben shemona chay, en shechitato metaharto, lefi sheen bemino shechita:
4.5: Hashshochet et habbehema umatza vah ben shemona chay o met, o ven tisha met, koro umotzi et damo. matza ven tisha chay, taun shechita, vechayyav beoto veet beno, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, shechitat immo metaharto. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, afillu ven shemone shanim vechoresh bassade, shechitat immo metaharto. keraah umatza vah ben tisha chay, taun shechita, lefi shello nishchata immo:
4.6: Behema shennechtechu ragleha min haarkubba ulematta, keshera. min haarkubba ulemala, pesula. vechen shennittal tzomet haggidin. nishbar haetzem, im rov habbasar kayyam, shechitato metaharto. veim lav, en shechitato metaharto:
4.7: Hashshochet et habbehema umatza vah shilya, nefesh hayyafa tochlenna, veenah metammea lo tumat ochalin velo tumat nevelot. chishshev aleha, metammea tumat ochalin aval lo tumat nevelot. shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah, asura vaachila. siman valad baishsha, vesiman valad babbehema. hamevakkeret shehippila shilya, yashlichenna lichlavim. uvammukdashin, tikkaver. veen kovrin otah befarashat derachim, veen tolin otah beilan, mifne darche haemori:

5.1: Oto veet beno, noheg ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin uvemukdashin. ketzad. hashshochet oto veet beno chullin bachutz, shenehem kesherim, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. kadashim bachutz, harishon chayyav karet, ushenehem pesulim, ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim. chullin bifnim, shenehem pesulim, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. kadashim bifnim, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul:
5.2: Chullin vekadashim bachutz, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul. kadashim vechullin bachutz, harishon chayyav karet ufasul, vehashsheni kasher, ushenehem sofgin et haarbaim. chullin vekadashim bifnim, shenehem pesulim, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim. kadashim vechullin bifnim, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul. chullin bachutz uvifnim, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul. kadashim bachutz uvifnim, harishon chayyav karet, ushenehem pesulim, ushenehem sofgim et haarbaim. chullin bifnim uvachutz, harishon pasul ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim vechasher. kadashim bifnim uvachutz, harishon kasher ufatur, vehashsheni sofeg et haarbaim ufasul:
5.3: Hashshochet venimtza terefa, hashshochet laavoda zara, vehashshochet parat chattat, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa, rabbi shimon poter, vachachamim mechayyevin. hashshochet venitnabbela veyado, vehannocher, vehammeakker, patur mishshum oto veet beno. shenayim shellakchu fara uvenah, eze shellakach rishon, yishchot rishon. veim kadam hashsheni, zacha. shachat para veachar kach shene vaneha, sofeg shemonim. shachat shene vaneha veachar kach shechatah, sofeg et haarbaim. shechatah veet bittah veet bat bittah, sofeg shemonim. shechatah veet bat bittah veachar kach shachat et bittah, sofeg et haarbaim. sumechos omer mishshum rabbi meir, sofeg shemonim. bearbaa ferakim bashshana hammocher behema lachavero tzarich lehodio, immah macharti lishchot, bittah macharti lishchot. veellu hen, erev yom tov haacharon shel chag, veerev yom tov harishon shel pesach, veerev atzeret, veerev rosh hashshana, uchedivre rabbi yose haggelili, af erev yom hakkippurim baggalil. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman sheen lo revach. aval yesh lo revach, en tzarich lehodio. umode rabbi yehuda bemocher et haem lechatan veet habbat lakkalla, shetztzarich lehodia, beyadua sheshshenehem shochatin beyom echad:
5.4: Bearbaa ferakim ellu mashchitin et hattabbach beal karcho. afillu shor shave elef dinarin veen lo lallokeach ella dinar, kofin oto lishchot, lefichach, im met, met lallokeach. aval bishar yemot hashshana, eno chen. lefichach, im met, met lammocher:
5.5: Yom echad haamur beoto veet beno, hayyom holech achar hallayla. et zo darash shimon ben zoma. neemar bemaase vereshit (Bereshit 1), yom echad, veneemar beoto veet beno (Vayikra 22), yom echad. ma yom echad haamur bemaase vereshit hayyom holech achar hallayla, af yom echad haamur beoto veet beno, hayom holech achar hallayla:

6.1: Kissuy haddam noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo vemukdashim. venoheg bechayya uveof, bimzumman uvesheeno mezumman. venoheg bechoy, mippene shehu safek. veen shochatin oto veyom tov. veim shechato, en mechassin et damo:
6.2: Hashshochet venimtza terefa, vehashshochet laavoda zara, vehashshochet chullin bifnim, vekadashim bachutz, chayya vaof hanniskalim, rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. hashochet venitnabbela veyado, hannocher, vehameakker, patur millechassot:
6.3: Cheresh, shote vekatan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan, chayyav lechassot. benan leven atzmam, patur millechassot. vechen leinyan oto veet beno, sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan, asur lishchot acharehem. benan leven atzman, rabbi meir mattir lishchot acharehen, vachachamim osrim. umodim sheim shachat, sheeno sofeg et haarbaim:
6.4: Shachat mea chayyot bemakom echad, kissuy echad lechullan. mea ofot bemakom echad, kissuy echad lechullan. chayya vaof bemakom echad, kissuy echad lechullan. rabbi yehuda omer, shachat chayya, yechassenna, veachar kach yishchot et haof. shachat velo chissa veraahu acher, chayyav lechassot. kissahu venitgalla, patur millechassot. kissahu haruach, chayyav lechassot:
6.5: Dam shennitarev bemayim, im yesh bo marit dam, chayyav lechassot. nitarev beyayin, roin oto cheillu hu mayim. nitarev bedam habbehema o vedam hachayya, roin oto cheillu hu mayim. rabbi yehuda omer, en dam mevattel dam:
6.6: Dam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin, chayyav lechassot. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman sheen sham dam ella hu. aval yesh sham dam shello hu, patur millechassot:
6.7: Bamme mechassin, uvamma en mechassin. mechassin bezevel haddak, uvechol haddak, besid, uvecharsit, uvilvena uvimgufa shekketashan. aval en mechassin lo vezevel haggas, velo vechol haggas, velo vilvena umegufa shelo chetashan, velo yichpe alav et hakkeli. kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, davar shemmegaddel bo tzemachin, mechassin bo. vesheeno megaddel tzemachin, en mechassin bo:

7.1: Gid hannashe noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin uvemukdashim. venoheg bivhema uvechayya, beyarech shel yamin uveyarech shel semol. veeno noheg beof, mippene sheen lo chaf. venoheg beshalil. rabbi yehuda omer, eno noheg beshalil. vechelbo muttar. veen hattabbachin neemanin al gid hannashe, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, neemanin alav veal hachelev:
7.2: Sholeach adam yarech lenachri sheggid hannashe vetochah, mippene shemmekomo nikkar. hannotel gid hannashe, tzarich sheyyittol et kullo. rabbi yehuda omer, kede lekayyem bo mitzvat netila:
7.3: Haochel miggid hannashe chazzayit, sofeg arbaim. achalo veen bo chazzayit, chayyav. achal mizze chazzayit umizze chazzayit, sofeg shemonim. rabbi yehuda omer, eno sofeg ella arbaim:
7.4: Yarech shennitbashshel bah gid hannashe, im yesh bah benoten taam, hare zo asura. ketzad meshaarin otah. kevasar belafet:
7.5: Gid hannashe shennitbashshel im haggidim, bizman shemmakkiro, benoten taam, veim lav, kullan asurin. veharotev, benoten taam. vechen chaticha shel nevela, vechen chaticha shel dag tame, shennitbashshelu im hachatichot, bizman shemmakkiran, benoten taam. veim lav, kullan asurot. veharotev, benoten taam:
7.6: Noheg bithora, veeno noheg bitmea. rabbi yehuda omer, af bitmea. amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo mibbene yaakov neesar gid hannashe, vaadayin behema temea mutteret lahen. amru lo, besinay neemar, ella shennichtav bimkomo:

8.1: Kol habbasar asur levashshel bechalav, chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim. veasur lehaaloto im haggevina al hashshulchan, chutz mibbesar dagim vachagavim. hannoder min habbasar, muttar bivsar dagim vachagavim. haof ole im haggevina al hashshulchan veeno neechol, divre vet shammay. uvet hillel omrim, lo ole velo neechol. amar rabbi yose, zo mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel. beeze shulchan amru, bashshulchan sheochel alav. aval bashshulchan shessoder alav et hattavshil, noten ze vetzad ze veeno choshesh:
8.2: Tzorer adam basar ugevina bemitpachat achat, uvilvad shello yehu nogin ze vaze. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, shene achsenain ochlin al shulchan echad, ze basar vaze gevina, veen choshshin:
8.3: Tippat chalav shennafla al hachaticha, im yesh bah benoten taam beotah chaticha, asur. nier et hakkedera, im yesh bah benoten taam beotah kedera, asur. hakkechal, koro umotzi et chalavo. lo kerao, eno over alav. hallev, koro umotzi et damo. lo kerao, eno over alav. hammaale et haof im haggevina al hashshulchan, eno over belo taase:
8.4: Besar behema tehora bachalev behema tehora, asur levashshel veasur bahanaa. besar behema tehora bachalev behema temea, besar behema temea bachalev behema tehora, muttar levashshel umuttar bahanaa. rabbi akiva omer, chayya vaof enam min hattora, shenneemar, lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo, shalosh peamim, perat lechayya uleof velivhema temea. rabbi yose haggelili omer, neemar (Devarim 14), lo tochlu chol nevela, veneemar (sham), lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo. et sheasur mishshum nevela, asur levashshel bechalav. of, sheasur mishshum nevela, yachol yehe asur levashshel bechalav, talmud lomar bachalev immo, yatza of, sheen lo chalev em:
8.5: Kevat nachri veshel nevela, hare zo asura. hammaamid beor shel keva cheshera, im yesh benoten taam, hare zo asura. keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa, kevatah asura. terefa sheyyanka min hakkeshera, kevatah mutteret, mippene shekkanus bemeeha:
8.6: Chomer bachelev mibbaddam, vechomer baddam mibbachelev. chomer bachelev, shehachelev moalin bo, vechayyavin alav mishshum piggul venotar vetame, ma sheen ken baddam. vechomer baddam, shehaddam noheg bivhema vechayya vaof, ben temeim uven tehorim, vechelev eno noheg ella bivhema tehora vilvad:

9.1: Haor, veharotev, vehakkippa, vehaelal, vehaatzamot, vehaggidin, vehakkarnayim, vehattelafayim, mitztarfin letamme tumat ochalim, aval lo tumat nevelot. kayyotze vo, hashshochet behema temea lenachri umefarkeset, metammea tumat ochalin, aval lo tumat nevelot, ad shettamut o ad sheyyattiz et roshah. ribba letamme tumat ochalin mimma sheribba letamme tumat nevelot. rabbi yehuda omer, haelal hamechunnas, im yesh bo chazzayit bemakom echad, chayyav alav:
9.2: Ellu sheorotehen kivsaran, or haadam, veor chazir shel yishshuv. rabbi yose omer, af or chazir habbar. veor chatoteret shel gamal harakka, veor harosh shel egel harach, veor happerasot, veor bet habboshet, veor hashshalil, veor shettachat haalya, veor haanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet. rabbi yehuda omer, halletaa chachulda. vechullan sheibbedan o shehillech bahen kede avoda, tehorin, chutz meor haadam. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, shemona sheratzim yesh lahen orot:
9.3: Hammafshit babbehema uvachayya, battehora uvattemea, baddakka uvaggassa, leshatiach, kede achiza. ulechemet, ad sheyyafshit et hechaze. hammargil, kullo chibbur lattuma, littame uletamme. or sheal hatztzavvar, rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, eno chibbur. vachachamim omrim, chibbur, ad sheyyafshit et kullo:
9.4: Or sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar, hannoge betziv hayyotze mimmennu, uvesaara shekkenegdo, tame. hayu alav kishne chatzae zetim, metamme vemassa velo vemagga, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, lo vemagga velo vemassa. umode rabbi akiva bishne chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam vehesitan, shehu tame. umippene ma rabbi akiva metaher baor, mippene shehaor mevattelan:
9.5: Kulit hammet vekulit hammukdashim, hannogea bahen, ben setumim ben nekuvim, tame. kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz, hannogea bahen setumim, tehorim. nekuvim kol shehu, mittamme vemagga. minnayin sheaf bemassa, talmud lomar (Vayikra 11), hannogea vehannose, et shebba lichlal magga, ba lichlal massa, lo va lichlal magga, lo va lichlal massa:
9.6: Betzat hashsheretz hamerukkemet, tehora. nikkeva chol shehu, temea. achbar shechetzyo vasar vechetzyo adama, hannogea babbasar, tame. baadama, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, af hannogea baadama shekkeneged habbasar, tame:
9.7: Haevar vehabbasar hameduldalin bivhema, metammein tumat ochalin bimkoman, utzerichin hechsher. nishchata vehema, huchsheru vedameha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer, lo huchsharu. meta habbehema, habbasar tzarich hechsher. haevar metamme mishshum evar min hachay veeno metamme mishshum evar nevela, divre rabbi meir. verabbi shimon metaher:
9.8: Haevar vehabbasar hameduldalin baadam, tehorin. met haadam, habbasar tahor. haevar metamme mishshum evar min hachay veeno metamme mishshum evar min hammet, divre rabbi meir. verabbi shimon metaher:

10.1: Hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagin baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo vemukdashin. shehaya vaddin, uma im hachullin, sheenan chayyavin bechaze vashok, chayyavin bammattanot, kadashim shechayyavin bechaze vashok, eno din shechayyavin bammattanot. talmud lomar (Vayikra 7), vaetten otam leaharon hakkohen ulevanav lechak olam, en lo ella ma sheamur bainyan:
10.2: Kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu, chayyavin babbechora uvammattanot, veyotzin lechullin, lehiggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz patur, veen osin temura, veim metu yippadu, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. kol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman, o mum over lehekdeshan, uleachar mikkan nolad lahem mum kavua venifdu, peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot, veenan yotzin lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz chayyav, veosin temura, veim metu, yikkaveru:
10.3: Bechor shennitarev bemea, bizman shemmea shochatin et kullan, potrin et kullan. echad shochet et kullan, potrin lo echad. hashshochet lechohen ulenachri, patur min hammattanot. vehammishtattef immahen, tzarich sheyyirshom. veim amar chutz min hammattanot, patur min hammattanot. amar, mechor li vene meeha shel para, vehayu vahen mattanot, notnan lechohen veeno menakke lo min haddamim. lakach hemennu vemishkal, notnan lechohen umenakke lo min haddamim:
10.4: Ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo fara, nishchata ad shello nitgayyer, patur. mishshennitgayyer, chayyav. safek, patur, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. ezehu hazzeroa, min happerek shel arkubba ad kaf shel yad. vehu shel nazir. uchenegdo varegel, shok. rabbi yehuda omer, shok, min happerek shel arkubba ad sovech shel ragel. ezehu lechi, min happerek shel lechi ad pikka shel gargaret:

11.1: Reshit haggez noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo vemukdashin. chomer bazzeroa uvallechayayim uvakkeva mereshit haggez, shehazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagim bevakar uvetzon, bimrubbe uvemuat, vereshit haggez eno noheg ella virchelot, veeno noheg ella vimrubbe:
11.2: Vechamma hu merubbe. bet shammay omrim, shete rechelot, shenneemar (yeshaya 7), yechayye ish eglat bakar ushete tzon. uvet hillel omrim, chamesh, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 25), chamesh tzon asuyot. rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer, chamesh rechelot gozzot mane mane uferas, chayyavot bereshit haggez. vachachamim omrim, chamesh rechelot gozzot kol shehen. vechamma notnin lo. mishkal chamesh selaim bihuda, shehen eser selaim baggalil, melubban velo tzoi, kede laasot mimmennu veged katan, shenneemar (Devarim 18), titten lo, sheyyehe vo chede mattana. lo hispik litteno lo ad shetztzevao, patur. libbeno velo tzevao, chayyav. hallokeach gez tzono shel nachri, patur mereshit haggez. hallokeach gez tzono shel chavero, im shiyyer hammocher, hammocher chayyav. lo shiyyer, hallokeach chayyav. hayu lo shene minim, shechufot ulevanot, machar lo shechufot aval lo levanot, zecharim aval lo nekevot, ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo:

12.1: Shilluach hakken, noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo vemukdashin. chomer bechissuy haddam mishshilluach hakken, shekkissuy haddam noheg bechayya uveof, bimzumman uvesheeno mezumman. veshilluach hakken, eno noheg ella veof, veeno noheg ella vesheeno mezumman. ezehu sheeno mezumman. kegon avvazin vetarnegolin shekkinnenu vefardes. aval im kinnenu bevayit, vechen yone haredsiot, patur mishshilluach:
12.2: Of tame, patur milleshalleach. of tame rovetz al betze of tahor, vetahor rovetz al betze of tame, patur milleshalleach. kore zachar, rabbi eliezer mechayyev, vachachamim potrin:
12.3: Hayta meofefet, bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken, chayyav leshalleach. en kenafeha nogot bakken, patur milleshalleach. en sham ella efroach echad o vetza achat, chayyav leshalleach, shenneemar (Devarim 22), kan, ken mikkol makom. hayu sham efrochin mafrichin o vetzim muzarot, patur milleshalleach, shenneemar (sham), vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim o al habbetzim, ma efrochin bene keyama, af betzim bene keyama, yatzu muzarot. uma habbetzim tzerichin leimman, af haefrochin tzerichin leimman, yatzu mafrichin. shillechah vechazra, shillechah vechazra, afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, chayyav, shenneemar (sham), shalleach teshallach. amar, hareni notel et haem umeshalleach et habbanim, chayyav leshalleach, shenneemar (sham), shalleach teshallach et haem. natal habbanim vehecheziran lakken veachar kach chazra haem alehem, patur milleshalleach:
12.4: Hannotel em al habbanim, rabbi yehuda omer, loke veeno meshalleach. vachachamim omrim, meshalleach veeno loke. ze hakkelal, kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase, en lokin aleha:
12.5: Lo yittol adam em al habbanim, afillu letaher et hammetzora. uma im mitzva kalla shehi cheissar, amra tora (Devarim 22), lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim, kal vachomer al mitzvot chamurot shebbattora:
